answer: An adversary as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The nebula counter is kept in relic and walnut shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3940 identities would post 2809 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
